measurements.label: Height
measurements.how: Barefoot, back to the wall. Steel tape from the floor; straight edge flat on the head.

measurements.label: Neck girth
measurements.how: Around the base of the neck.

measurements.label: Shoulder width
measurements.how: Shoulder point to shoulder point, across the back.

measurements.label: Shoulder length
measurements.how: Side of the neck to the shoulder point.

measurements.label: Bust girth
measurements.how: Around the fullest part of the bust, tape level.

measurements.label: Under-bust girth
measurements.how: Around the ribcage just below the bust.

measurements.label: Chest girth
measurements.how: Around the fullest part of the chest, under the arms.

measurements.label: Bust point to bust point
measurements.how: Straight across, from one bust point to the other.

measurements.label: Shoulder to bust point
measurements.how: From the side of the neck down to the bust point.

measurements.label: Front length
measurements.how: Side of the neck to the waist, at the front (over the bust for women).

measurements.label: Back length
measurements.how: From the neck bone at the back (nape) down to the waist.

measurements.label: Waist girth
measurements.how: Around the natural waist (the narrowest part).

measurements.label: High hip girth
measurements.how: Around the body about 10 cm below the waist.

measurements.label: Hip girth
measurements.how: Around the fullest part of the hips.

measurements.label: Waist to hip
measurements.how: At the side, from the waist down to the fullest part of the hip.

measurements.label: Arm length
measurements.how: Shoulder point to wrist bone, arm hanging relaxed.

measurements.label: Upper arm girth
measurements.how: Around the fullest part of the upper arm.

measurements.label: Wrist girth
measurements.how: Around the wrist, just above the wrist bone.

measurements.label: Inseam
measurements.how: From the crotch down the inside of the leg to the ankle bone.

measurements.label: Outseam
measurements.how: From the waist down the side of the leg to the ankle bone.

measurements.label: Thigh girth
measurements.how: Around the fullest part of the thigh.

measurements.label: Knee girth
measurements.how: Around the middle of the knee.

measurements.label: Calf girth
measurements.how: Around the fullest part of the calf.

measurements.label: Waist to knee
measurements.how: From the waist down to the middle of the knee (skirt length).

measurements.label: Shoulder to knee
measurements.how: From the side of the neck at the shoulder down to the knee (dress length).
